lecture_beats.subject: Minimal polarization system, wire-grid physics, preparation, testing, and continuity versus discreteness
Axial notation, orthonormal basis, outcome labels, and the first observable
Diagonal basis, Born probabilities, diagonal observable, and state-dependent definiteness
Arbitrary-angle basis, trigonometric overlap, and Malus's law
Intermediate-polarizer route and crossed-polarizer color question
Spectral and matrix forms of the arbitrary linear observable
Complex amplitudes, circular and elliptical polarization, and circular observable
Expectation-value motivation, spectral derivation, and polarization example

resolved_source_issues.issue: Grid lines and polarization axis can be confused.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter explicitly distinguishes the conducting direction from the transmitted electric-field direction.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The spoken coordinate discussion mixes arbitrary convention with physical constraints.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Normalization, orthogonality, and global-phase equivalence are stated separately.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The matrix derivation is spread across fragmented board narration.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The spectral construction is expanded into a complete matrix and verified on its plus eigenvector.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The spoken wave argument suppresses dimensions in the phase.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter uses phi = kz - omega t with omega = ck.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Handedness conventions and the conditions for circular versus elliptical polarization are compressed.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The convention dependence and exact amplitude-phase conditions are made explicit.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Different axes and merely relabelled orthogonal axes can sound equally incompatible.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The commutator and the identity P(theta + pi/2) = -P(theta) separate the cases.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Expectation value may be mistaken for an expected single outcome.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The two-lobe example and spectral derivation identify it as an ensemble average.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The source video has limited image resolution.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Frames retain board evidence while every equation is independently typeset.

uncertain_sources.note: The lecture leaves the crossed-polarizer color mechanism open; the response retains that fact and adds the standard birefringence explanation explicitly.
The optical-device exchange is terse; the quarter-wave plate description supplies the standard phase-delay mechanism.
The spoken condition for circular polarization is incomplete; the exact equal-magnitude, quarter-cycle condition is used.
